tells.1: The filler setup line "The consequences are significant:" before a list of bold-lead-in bullets, a templated AI pattern.
tells.2: Bold-lead-in bullets introduced by "The effects add up:"; otherwise the contractions and rhythm read naturally.
tells.3: The counted announcement "This causes four problems:" before the list.
tells.5: The counted announcement "This hurts in four ways:" combined with bold-lead-in bullets.

reason: Version 4 is the plainest and most credible as a PRD: it has no filler setup lines, no counted announcements and no decorative bold, and it is precise without the casual tone of version 2. Version 2 has the strongest human voice, but its conversational register is a little loose for a spec.
